visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontally scrolling row of award cards with prev/next arrows
description: Multi-item slider of small white award cards (logo, title, description) with round arrows, on gradient section

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: award logo image; cell 2: bold title paragraph followed by a description paragraph. Shows 1/2/3 cards at mobile/tablet/desktop
notes: Award cards sit in a slider with prev/next arrows (interactive, repeating).

usage: Use for awards, accolades or recognition cards shown in a slider.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any multi-item card slider of small logo + text cards; arrows hide when all cards fit.
